versions.changelog:
- Initial release of kpn-korea-content skill.
- Provides verified judgment for Korean content (K-pop, drama, webtoon, beauty, games, film) in business and regulatory contexts.
- Cross-checked by a panel of Korean experts; only issues judgments when confident (otherwise HOLD).
- Answers business-critical, decision-oriented questions—does not provide simple lookups or public facts.
- Async operation: submit question, then poll for result (free preview active, daily limit applies).
- Each verdict includes official sources, a trust score, and an audit ID for re-verification.
